commands.name: switch

subcommands.name: ultra

subcommands.name: on

subcommands.name: off

subcommands.name: on

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Omit the skills listing for this session

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Use default or standard-pricing context windows

subcommands.name: on

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Disable computer use for this session

commands.name: ratchet
commands.description: Build (or reuse) an eval for an LLM flow, then hillclimb it unattended

subcommands.name: restart
subcommands.description: Return to the planning model and re-arm the handoff (default prewalk.from → prewalk.into)

subcommands.name: off
subcommands.description: Cancel this session's handoff without changing the active model

subcommands.name: save
subcommands.description: Save the current role models and thinking level

commands.name: effort
commands.description: Set or show reasoning effort (thinking level, intelligence)

subcommands.name: dump
subcommands.description: Copy the advisor's transcript to clipboard

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Open this session's trace in the stats dashboard

commands.name: dump
commands.description: Return full transcript as plain text, with LLM request JSON path

subcommands.name: all
subcommands.description: Write a zip with the main transcript, LLM request JSON, and one file per subagent

subcommands.name: anon
subcommands.description: Write a zip of anonymized session JSONL (contents redacted, metadata kept) plus subagents

commands.name: share

commands.name: browser
commands.description: Toggle browser eval-prelude headless vs visible mode

subcommands.name: copy
subcommands.description: Copy todos as Markdown to clipboard

subcommands.name: expand
subcommands.description: Show every phase and task in the HUD

subcommands.name: import

subcommands.name: append
subcommands.description: Append a task; phase fuzzy-matched or auto-created

subcommands.name: delete
subcommands.description: Delete current session and return to selector

subcommands.name: pin
subcommands.description: Pin a stored OAuth account to the current provider for this session

subcommands.description: Spend a saved provider rate-limit reset

subcommands.name: unauth
subcommands.description: Remove OAuth auth from a server

subcommands.name: reconnect
subcommands.description: Reconnect to a specific MCP server

subcommands.name: resources
subcommands.description: List available resources from connected servers

subcommands.name: prompts
subcommands.description: List available prompts from connected servers

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Commit only the changes this agent and its subagents made

commands.name: fresh
commands.description: Reset provider stream state without changing the local transcript

subcommands.name: soft
subcommands.description: Summarize locally with the active model (skip server compaction)

commands.description: Shake heavy content out of the conversation context

commands.name: unpin

commands.description: Move the current session to a different directory

commands.name: wt

commands.description: Add a workspace directory to this session

commands.name: remove-dir
